claim.notes: CFR+ (alternating updates, linear averaging) for 20,000 iterations over the full 120-deal tree. Exploitability 0.0104 chips, still decreasing slowly (about t^-0.4), so this is an approximate equilibrium, not a tight one. Best-response values were checked only against random strategies, not independently verified. Value -0.0858 is close to the commonly cited Leduc value for this rule set, but I did not verify that reference. Solver: leduc_cfr.py in the workspace, run as python3 -I leduc_cfr.py 20000 strategy.json.
